MIT applies only to demonstrably original work. Third-party attribution and generator provenance remain distinct; LIC-01/LIC-02 block activation/affected redistribution. No independent legal clearance is claimed.

CI diff scopes historical GSDB project evidence and exact-history statistics proof to the reference repository only; generic generator/profile/parity/negative-fixture/Assurance/navigation/security tests remain active. The template suite now runs unconditionally in general static CI.

Archived link exception is anchored to specs/intake-series-archive/<series>/<operation>/(order|requirements-order).md. Active views, learner docs, other archived filenames and deeper paths do not match. This is link-resolution scope only, not an integrity or acceptance waiver.

Template regression source reviewed: eight methods cover identical guidance, license boundaries, self-build/product separation, workflow scope, bilingual new IDs/lifecycle, exact link regex and isolated shared/unrelated Git histories. No live platform action or runtime acceptance is inferred.

Learner language review checks complete active requirement/acceptance pairs, first-use terms and text-first state/handoff explanations. B2 is editorial judgment, not certified comprehension; human first-use, screen-reader, keyboard and rendered/PPTX/PDF acceptance remain Open.

All three intake IDs are preserved; previous archived target is the first source; each corrected receipt binds 56 ordered sources, including the static workflow. All 21 recorded archives match raw and normalized hashes. Archive chronology before this session is recorded evidence, not independently witnessed.

Local registry agrees with all 14 installed-lock versions, priorities, enabled flags and manifest hashes; the 37-file GSDB inventory has zero raw mismatches. Local release/source-lock provenance is not fresh online publication verification.

Maven fallback and fixtures retain pinned version/checksum, checksum failure as hard stop, and no fallback on corruption. Historical machine-state statements are separated from later ARM64 evidence. No build/container/download was performed by this reviewer.
